en: The Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Lingyou of Mount Gui in Tanzhou,
compiled by the Sramana Yufeng of Mount Jing, Yuanxin, Wudi Dizhu, and Guo Ningzhi.
The Master’s name was Lingyou.
He was the son of the Zhao family from Changxi in Fuzhou.
At the age of fifteen, he left the household life to become a monk.
He received the tonsure from Vinaya Master Fachang at Jianshan Temple in his native district.
At Longxing Temple in Hangzhou,
he thoroughly studied the teachings of both the Mahāyāna and Hīnayāna vehicles.
